concerns.text: T005 is not deterministically executable because the unit of modeling is contradictory across artifacts: plan.md says 'Train Elastic Net per gene using LOOCV' while T005 and model_output.schema.yaml (one 200-coefficient vector per `elastic_net_{cell_line}.pkl`) specify a per-cell-line model. An implementer cannot decide what one training run is. Also the hyperparameter roles conflict: spec US2 says 'α=0.5, λ via CV' while T005 fixes 'l1_ratio=0.5' and tunes α. Resolve both before T005 can be executed.

Verification checks only 'RAM < 7 GB and runtime < 6 h'. Constitution Principle VI additionally requires 'total runtime per cell line must not exceed 2 hours' verified via profiling logs. Add a per-cell-line 2h check against logs/profiling.log so the verification is complete and checkable.

T002 cites 'https://ftp.eensembl.org/' — a malformed/nonexistent host — alongside the correct 'https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/gencode/...' mirror. The canonical GENCODE source must be a single unambiguous URL or the implementer cannot satisfy constitution Principle I (same canonical source every run).

T008 requires prepending the caveat 'from docs/LIMITATIONS_MASTER.md (T009)' to the report header, but the execution-order section says 'T009 can run in parallel with T005–T007' and lists T008 in the T001→T008 chain without T009. An implementer following the stated order hits a missing input. State explicitly that T009 must precede T008 (or that T008 runs after T009).

T006's external validation 'training on 4 cell lines and testing on the held-out fifth' does not state the target of the R² being computed (per-gene predictions aggregated how? which model family/hyperparameters — same LOOCV-tuned Elastic Net?). Given N=3–5 samples per line, the implementer needs the exact train/test setup (features from the 4 training lines' bins, target = held-out line's expression, R² over genes) spelled out to execute deterministically.
